name: GPU Deployment Safety Checks
description: Lessons from repeated cuda:0 dual-process conflicts — mandatory pre-deploy GPU check, kill child processes not just tmux, naming conventions
type: feedback

Agent must check `nvidia-smi` on the target GPU before deploying any experiment. Three incidents of dual-process GPU conflicts on this project (bjb2-40593 ghost, bjb1-18228 cuda:0 x2).

**Why:** Cron auto-retry, manual re-deploy, and naming confusion (norm03 vs norm003) led to multiple processes on same GPU, wasting 9+ GPU-hours. Worker kills sometimes only killed tmux sessions, leaving orphan python child processes alive.

**How to apply:**
1. Before deploying: `nvidia-smi -i <gpu_id> --query-compute-apps=pid,name --format=csv` to verify GPU is free
2. When killing: `kill -9 <python_pid> <bash_wrapper_pid>`, not just tmux kill — then verify with `ps -p`
3. After submit_training_job failure: check if cron already auto-retried before manually resubmitting
4. Naming: use full decimal in exp_id (e.g., `norm-0p3` not `norm03`) to avoid confusion with `norm-0p03`
